chunks: My father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bezanti who said:

It occurred to me to ask Abi Al-Hasan Al-Rida (peace be upon him) about his age when I entered upon him. When I entered upon him and sat in front of him, he looked at me and scrutinized my face, then said: 'How old are you?' I said: 'May I be your ransom, such and such.' He said: 'I am older than you. Forty-two years have passed over me.' I said: 'May I be your ransom, by God I intended to ask you about this.' He said: 'I have informed you.'

key_terms.جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ: May I be your ransom (a common honorific address to the Imams)
key_terms.هَوَيْتُ فِي نَفْسِي: It occurred to me / I inclined towards my soul (internal thought)

ai.seo_question: What is the account of Imam Al-Rida's age and his knowledge of the narrator's thoughts?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the Imam’s *‘ilm al-ghayb* (knowledge of the unseen) through a subtle psychological insight, as he discerned the narrator’s unspoken curiosity about his age before the question was voiced. By stating 'I have become older than you' and specifying forty-two years, Imam al-Rida (a.s.) not only confirms his age but also subtly asserts his seniority and authority in the spiritual hierarchy, a key indicator of divine leadership (*Imamah*). This incident is frequently cited by Shia scholars to demonstrate the infallible Imam’s awareness of the inner states (*khawaṭir*) of his companions.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 47-34 (The author of the book narrated) my father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’d ibn Abdullah quoted on the authority of Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abil Khattab, on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bezanti, “

It occurred to me to ask Abil Hassan Ar-Ridha’ (a.s.) about his age when I saw him. When I went to see him and sat in front of him, the Imam (a.s.) turned to me, looked at me and asked, ‘How old are you?’ I said, ‘May I be your ransom! I am so many years old.’ The Imam (a.s.) said, ‘I am older than you are. I am forty-two years old.’ I said, ‘May I be your ransom! I wanted to ask you about your age.’ The Imam (a.s.) said, ‘I told you.’”
